title: Unicode token bridge and template consistency audit for onboarding
creator: Priya Shah
description: Background: During recent model onboards we observed subtle mismatches between tokenizer byte/char handling for control and non-BMP Unicode characters and the chat template serializer. These mismatches cause a small class of pinned model rollouts to produce off-by-one token counts, unexpected role boundary insertion, or trimming of leading control characters in system messages. Goal: Create a deterministic 'Unicode token bridge' verification step in the onboarding pipeline plus a lightweight template consistency audit that runs before publishing performance profiles or pinning releases. The bridge should normalize encoding edge-cases without changing downstream semantic tokens, produce an audit report for PR reviewers, and gate profile publishing when anomalies are detected.
approach_summary: 1) Add a reproducible canonicalization pass that simulates the runtime tokenization + chat-template serializer for the model bundle. 2) Generate a compact checksum + mapping table for each sample prompt set to detect byte->token divergences. 3) Wire a gating rule into the onboarding pipeline: anomaly -> fail publish, with ability to create an allowed-exceptions list anchored to a reviewer and reason. 4) Add targeted smoke tests and telemetry signals (token_delta, role_boundary_score) to Console before full rollout.

acceptance_criteria: Canonicalization harness reproduces runtime tokenization + serializer for 99.95% of samples in our eval corpus
Onboarding pipeline runs the audit and blocks publish on >0 token-delta anomalies until reviewer approves or exemption is recorded
Audit report includes per-sample token mapping, checksum, and suggested mitigation (template tweak or tokenizer shim)
Telemetry metrics appear in Console with dashboards and at-least-one alert definition for spike in tokenizer.token_delta
Integration tests covering non-BMP and combining marks pass in CI and are enforced for future PRs
One partner onboarding run completed end-to-end using the new gate with documented reviewer decision

notes_and_tradeoffs: Tradeoffs: aggressive normalization reduces spurious onboarding failures but risks masking upstream tokenizer regressions — we preserve raw artifacts and require reviewer-anchored exemptions to mitigate. We avoid changing model bundles during gate; instead we prefer template tweaks or tokenizer shim recommendations. Long term we may push fixes into tokenizer metadata in model bundles.
